posts.title: Post 5982
posts.description: Trying out an inspect block as a way to peek into the context of the images I collage on the tabletop. For a long time I thought I'd do this as more of a sidebar, but I've been working to avoid sidebars. I like that it has the flexibility of the other blocks - can be pinned like in this demo, or live in the canvas world, can have multiple.
